questions.prompt: What are your legal ego name, operational callsign, and known mesh aliases?
questions.lore_text: In the solar system after the Fall, identity is layered across SIN registries, anonymous mesh handles, and Firewall cell callsigns.

questions.prompt: How old is your ego (chronologically vs. subjectively), and were you instantiated pre-Fall or post-Fall?
questions.lore_text: Time dilation, egocast latency, cold storage, and fork merges mean two people born the same year rarely share the same subjective age.

questions.prompt: What morph or sleeve do you currently inhabit, and how long have you been wearing it?
questions.lore_text: From baseline splicers and Olympic biomorphs to neo-avian uplifts and synthetic cyberbrains, your shell shapes every sensation.

questions.prompt: What is your origin background (Earth survivor, habitat-born, hypercorp, autonomist, uplift, AGI, lost generation) and primary faction alignment?
questions.lore_text: Your formative culture determines whether you trust corporate credit, gift-economy mutual aid, or secretive containment protocols.

questions.prompt: What is your primary operational specialty or cover occupation?
questions.lore_text: Even covert operatives maintain plausible trade skills: xenobiologists, mesh forensics specialists, gatecrashers, or zero-g riggers.

questions.prompt: Summarize your life story across the Fall, your past origins (6.1), and your current post-Fall routine (6.2).
questions.lore_text: Almost every transhuman carries a fault line dividing who they were before the TITANs from who survived afterward.

questions.prompt: Give a concise overview of your current physical appearance, demeanor, and immediate first impression.
questions.lore_text: Although morphs can be customized or swapped, posture, scars, and habits tend to survive resleeving.

questions.prompt: Where do you currently reside or keep your primary berth, and which orbital/planetary sectors do you know best?
questions.lore_text: Whether docked in Titanian habitats, Martian domes, or scavenger tin cans in the Belt, location dictates survival.

questions.prompt: Why do you risk continuity loss on containment, reconnaissance, or deep-space operations instead of living safely inside a simspace?
questions.lore_text: Safe virtual comfort is cheap; stepping into existential hazards requires curiosity, guilt, duty, or desperation.

questions.prompt: What major secrets, bounties, legal complications, or hidden anomalies shadow your file?
questions.lore_text: Redacted entries in a dossier are often the exact levers hostile factions—or your own proxy—will pull.

questions.prompt: Describe your core personality, ethical boundaries, and transhuman philosophy (expands into 11a–11x).
questions.lore_text: Forking, psychosurgery, and ubiquitous surveillance force every agent to decide what remains sacred.

questions.prompt: Detail your physical silhouette, distinctive marks, gear aesthetics, and vocal mannerisms (expands into 12A–12D).
questions.lore_text: Fine-grained physical and behavioral tells anchor an ego in the real world—or betray a covert infiltration.

questions.prompt: Who are the most important people, mentors, or threats in your life, and what bonds define you (expands into 13a–13e)?
questions.lore_text: Connections across light-minute lag require deliberate effort—and give enemies targets to exploit.

questions.prompt: How do you approach combat, infosec, investigation, and team survival in the field (expands into 14a–14h)?
questions.lore_text: Surviving an exsurgent outbreak or covert op relies on habits drilled long before alarms go off.

questions.prompt: What unresolved mysteries, immediate goals, and breaking-point hooks drive your campaign arc (expands into 15a–15f)?
questions.lore_text: Great dossiers live across sessions—tracking how missions alter convictions, scars, and ambitions.

questions.prompt: Capture your character's voice, inspirational touchstones, and any out-of-character notes for the GM (expands into 16a–16c).
questions.lore_text: Tone alignment keeps grim transhuman horror and tense tabletop espionage cohesive for the entire table.
